title: Pure Flower Cardian
summary: Pure Flower Cardian Hanafuda gambling combo build, composed almost exclusively of archetype monsters to guarantee continuous draw triggers. The deck rapidly draws and stacks cards, treats materials as Level 2, and climbs into multi-material Synchro bosses that negate Spells, burn the opponent, and freeze the graveyard.

summary.title: Starters & Draw Engine
points: Flower Gathering summons four 100-ATK Flower Cardians with different names (Pine, Zebra Grass, Willow, Paulownia) directly from the Deck at the cost of locking your summons to Flower Cardians.

Flower Stacking stacks three Flower Cardians with different names onto the top of your Deck in any order, guaranteeing successive draw-and-summon triggers, and banishes itself from the GY to recover any Flower Cardian to the hand.
Flower Cardian Pine draws 1 card on Normal Summon; if it is a Flower Cardian monster, it can be kept, otherwise it is sent to the GY.
Flower Cardian Cherry Blossom with Curtain reveals itself to draw 1 card; revealing a Flower Cardian summons Curtain and draws an extra card.

Flower Cardian Cherry Blossom summons itself next to a Level 2 or lower Flower Cardian, tributes a Cardian to draw 1, and on a Cardian draw adds any Flower Cardian monster from your Deck to your hand.

summary.title: The Special Summon Ladder
points: The with monsters (Pine with Crane, Zebra Grass with Moon, Willow with Calligrapher, Paulownia with Phoenix) tribute a specific matching Level Cardian to Special Summon themselves and draw a card.
Clover with Boar and Maple with Deer tribute any Flower Cardian monster to summon themselves, draw 1 card, and destroy an opponent's monster or Spell/Trap respectively if a Cardian is revealed.

Flower Cardian Peony with Butterfly and Willow with Calligrapher are Tuners that can treat all other monsters used for a Synchro Summon as Level 2, making 3-, 4-, and 5-material Synchro Summons possible.

summary.title: Opening: Flower Stacking
steps: Activate Flower Stacking to place Flower Cardian Pine, Flower Cardian Pine with Crane, and Flower Cardian Peony with Butterfly on top of your Deck in order.
Normal Summon Flower Cardian Pine to draw Flower Cardian Pine with Crane.
Tribute Pine to Special Summon Flower Cardian Pine with Crane, drawing the stacked Flower Cardian Peony with Butterfly.
Tribute Pine with Crane to Special Summon Peony with Butterfly; Peony treats all other materials as Level 2 monsters for Synchro Summons.
Use Peony with Butterfly and accumulated Cardians to Synchro Summon Flower Cardian Moonflowerviewing (Level 6), drawing and extending further.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Flower Cardian Lightflare (Level 10) requires 5 materials: once per turn as a Quick Effect, it negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card and destroys it, negates effects of monsters it battles, and floats into another Flower Cardian Synchro if it leaves the field.

Flower Cardian Lightshower (Level 8) requires 4 materials: prevents your Flower Cardian monsters from being targeted or destroyed by effects, and burns the opponent for 1500 damage whenever they draw a card in their Draw Phase.
Flower Cardian Moonflowerviewing (Level 6 Synchro Tuner) draws a card upon summon and allows you to Special Summon it if it is a Flower Cardian, treating all materials as Level 2.
Flower Cardian Boardefly (Level 6) requires 3 materials: inflicts piercing damage and locks down opponent GY effects until the end of their turn.

summary.title: Spells
points: Super Koi Koi excavates the top 3 cards of the Deck, Special Summoning all Flower Cardian monsters among them while sending the rest to the GY.
Recardination targets and adds a Flower Cardian monster from the GY to the hand, then Special Summons a Flower Cardian from the hand ignoring summoning conditions.
Super All In! returns all Synchro Monsters you control to the Extra Deck to revive 4 Flower Cardian monsters from your GY, then Synchro Summons immediately with them.
